svg.text: Figure 3.16 Level-2 Data Flow Diagram - Predictive Analytics
Cohort, to feature vector, to a stored and auditable run
OMITTED, never sent as a zero
so the page never hangs on a dead socket
the share of key features grounded in real
data rather than imputed by the pipeline
one header + one score row per employee,
each with its exact feature snapshot
the ranked list - or the last stored run
No prediction is ever written onto the employee record. Each assessment is a run, so an old score stays auditable against the inputs it was given.
